purpose: Teach: イースト/アーチ/大リーグ/サーモン/マイレージ/聖歌/ダイアナ/カッパ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、パン作りのイースト菌に拘ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently one of your customers is really particular about the yeast he uses for his bread.
lines.style: Leaning-in gossip hush. Soft, delighted pace, a little wonder blooming on the word yeast.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨーロッパ旅行で石造りのアーチを撮影されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And one customer photographed stone arches all over her trip through Europe, Mei.
lines.style: Warm conspiratorial reply. Easy café rhythm, smiling through the stone arches, trailing into a fond hum.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大リーグの試合を毎晩観てらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of the customers apparently watches the major league games every single night.
lines.style: Brighter, tickled. Quick playful pace, mock disbelief lifting the phrase every single night.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サーモンのお寿司がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of them loves salmon sushi, apparently, Mei.
lines.style: Soft laugh folded into the opening. Relaxed pace, affectionate emphasis on salmon sushi.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、航空マイレージを貯めるのがお得意だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one customer is apparently a real pro at racking up airline mileage.
lines.style: Impressed hush. Slower, savoring the word pro, eyebrows practically audible in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、教会で聖歌を歌うご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And one of them sings hymns at church as a hobby, Mei.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. Unhurried pace, the word hymns handled softly, like something lovely.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ダイアナ妃の伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of them was reading a biography of Princess Diana, you know.
lines.style: Confiding drop in volume. Slow, savoring delivery, a wistful note curling around the princess's name.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、河童、つまりカッパの民話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And one customer told me a folk tale about kappa — the river spirits, Mei.
lines.style: Delighted storyteller's close. Warm, unhurried pace, a soft laugh escaping on the river spirits.
